experiment: E2c confirmatory: boundary-recentred block-bootstrap calibration from finite null history
basis: CODEX_REVIEW of E2b (exp_E2/E2b/CODEX_REVIEW.md); E2b PH1/PH2 were exploratory; nothing below is tuned on E2c data

conditions.other: pi .1, d 500 constant delay, H 29,999, tau 10,000, harmful r .05->.20

monitor_exclusion_rationale: e-SR, mSR, EWMA excluded a priori: in E2b they had the largest residual FA failures even with recentring and 5H histories (PH2: 16 of 19 failing cells), i.e. the exploratory stage already gave no support for finite-history calibration of these monitors; E2c tests the restricted claim for the four monitors that the exploratory evidence did not contradict. Their E2/E2b results stand as reported (not controlled).

procedure.RC: boundary-recentred moving-block bootstrap: one null history (length per arm) of the true variant, same q, d=500, labels with origin <= history length; blocks of L items with starts uniform on the 50-item board grid; concatenated to H items; arrival=origin+500; labels after H dropped; every bootstrap label flipped independently so that its marginal rate is r0=0.10 (0->1 w.p. (r0-rhat)/(1-rhat) if rhat<r0, else 1->0 w.p. 1-r0/rhat; rhat = history miss rate); B=2000 per L; randomized calibrate_threshold at 0.02 on bootstrap maxima (const null); threshold = max over L in {50,250,1000} (fixed rule carried over from E2b, not tuned).
procedure.NR: in-control arm only: identical but without recentring (bootstrap at the history rate)

primary_arm: primary (10H history, r=0.10 boundary history, RC); 1H/5H = learning curve (secondary); incontrol (10H history at r=0.05; NR vs RC) = secondary
comparators: iid-nominal and oracle thresholds = E2 sim.calibrate (20,000 calibration streams/null path, E2 seeds)

seeds.history: role pilot, condition 5000+100*arm_id+10*q_index, replicate k (CRN across variants)
seeds.per_history_validation: role validation, condition 7000+100*arm_id+10*q_index+path_index, replicates k*M..k*M+M-1, M=10 (independent across histories)
seeds.pools: role validation (nulls) / evaluation (harm), condition 7900+10*q_index+path_index, 10,000 streams, shared by all histories and arms

inference.unconditional_FA: each history k paired with its own M=10 fresh validation streams per null path; estimate = mean of the K*M indicators; clusters (histories) i.i.d.; bound = cluster (history) bootstrap percentile, B=200,000, one-sided at 1-0.05/F; exact CP on one stream per history (first replicate) reported as a check
inference.conditional_reliability: FA_k = FA of history-k threshold on the shared pool (10,000 streams); key secondary = one-sided 95% CP upper bound (Bonferroni over F=64) on P_history(FA_k > 0.03) from the count of histories with pooled FA_k > 0.03 (FA_k measured with sd ~0.0017)

families.primary: 64 cells = 4 variants x 2 q x 4 monitors x 2 null paths (const .10, .05->.10 at tau) in the primary arm
families.secondary_arms: same bounds per arm, reported descriptively with the same per-cell F

success_criterion: PRIMARY: in the primary arm every one of the 64 cells has cluster-bootstrap simultaneous one-sided 95% upper bound on unconditional FA <= 0.03. KEY SECONDARY: 95% upper bound (F=64) on P_history(FA_k > 0.03) <= 0.10 in every cell. Both reported per cell and as counts.
price: p_D at D=5k/10k/20k on the shared harmful pool (10,000 streams) averaged over histories, its 5/50/95% distribution over histories, median detection delay among timely detections, threshold dispersion (sd, 5/95% of h over histories) vs the oracle threshold; reported, not a criterion
compute_plan: <=4 threads, chunks of 5,000 streams, RAM < 2 GB; cost dominated by 6,000 bootstrap streams x 4 monitors per history; histories total: primary 8x1000, curves 2x8x500, incontrol 8x500
not_tuned: L rule, B, M, K and recentring fixed before any E2c data were generated
